Values & Story

More than just
lines of code.

I am Sachin Jaiswal—more like a family man, friendly, hardworking, and eager to learn.

Growing up far from the world of code, I never imagined technology would one day become my canvas. From school days filled with cricket matches, to a college journey where lines of HTML and CSS gave me goosebumps—my fascination with how things work behind the screen only grew stronger.

"Without a tech background in my family, every new framework, every working project felt like discovering a new superpower. And the best part? Sharing these small wins with my true friends and family, who cheered for every line of code that finally worked."

This is just the start of my story.

FAQs

I specialize in clean, scalable code and regular updates. You'll receive weekly milestone reports and have access to a live staging environment to track progress in real-time.

Typically, a standard revision takes 2-3 business days. Full project timelines depend on scope, but I prioritize speed without compromising quality.

I offer Full Stack Development (MERN), UI/UX implementation, API Testing/Integration, and Performance Optimization for modern web applications.

We work iteratively. I provide initial wireframes and style guides for approval before coding. If you're not satisfied, we refine it until it matches your vision.

Milestone-based payments ensure safety for both parties. If a project is cancelled before work begins on a milestone, that portion is fully refundable.
